history.body: Hi, we’re looking around Seberang Jaya for a place to buy and Pearl Residences came up. We have a young child and need a separate bedroom for them, so could you tell me about the 3-bedroom layout and the usual monthly costs?

Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq.ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, so it has a separate bedroom that could be your child’s room. The plan also avoids a long internal corridor, with the living, dining and kitchen in an open-plan arrangement. Exact furniture fit is best checked against the approved plan.

The maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq.ft. inclusive of sinking fund, which works out to about RM162 per month for 900 sq.ft. I don’t have verified details of any other recurring charges, so I’ll confirm those rather than give you an incomplete monthly total.

That sounds promising for our own stay; a separate room for our child is important, and the open-plan area could work for us. Please let me know what other regular charges there are when you’ve confirmed them. Also, is a car park included in the price?

It depends on the unit category. The pricing structure can list a car-park premium separately, and some configurations show two bays, so I can’t confirm what’s included for a specific unit without the latest schedule. I’ll verify that rather than guess. The other recurring charges are still awaiting confirmation; I’ll share the breakdown once it’s verified. Glad the layout sounds promising for your family’s own stay. If you’d like, I can also arrange a viewing so you can get a feel for the space.
